rundown: 76ers beat Heat 111-104 at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PA. 76ers led 62-53 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: 76ers won it 33-21.
Leading the way — Heat: Giannis Antetokounmpo 32 pts, 14 reb; Davion Mitchell 10 ast. 76ers: Tyrese Maxey 30 pts; LeBron James 12 ast, 10 reb.
Where 76ers won it: they shot 47% to 45%, shot 40% from three to 26% and had 29 assists to 24.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Heat closed as 1.5-point favorites and lost outright to 76ers; the total closed at 237.5 and they combined for 215, under by 22.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 25, 10:44 AM ET. It had Heat 65% and 76ers 35%, projecting Heat 124.8 – 76ers 120.1 (244.9 total, Heat by 4.7).

Final: Heat 104 – 76ers 111. Wrong winner: it had Heat at 65%, and 76ers (35%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Heat came in with a 4% above average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (10-6, 120.7 scored and 119.4 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 97 and 96 games of evidence. Projected to score 124.8, they scored 104 (−20.8 points, 17% under); projected to allow 120.1, they allowed 111 (−9.1 points, 8% under).

76ers came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (14-4, 115.3 scored and 113.4 allowed a game over 18 games), worth about 105 and 104 games of evidence. Projected to score 120.1, they scored 111 (−9.1 points, 8% under); projected to allow 124.8, they allowed 104 (−20.8 points, 17% under).

The bigger miss was Heat's scoring (-20.8 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 215 against 244.9 projected (-29.9), about the 5th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: 76ers by 7 against Heat by 4.7 projected, about the 84th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): 76ers ×1.00, Heat ×1.02. It favored Heat, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
PHI ML (-125) at -125: the algo gave it 52% vs 53% fair (-1.7 pts) — won (+0.8u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 50%). MIA ML (+105) at +105: the algo gave it 48% vs 47% fair (+1.7 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the close (closing fair chance 50%). PHI -1.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-1.8 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the closing +1.5 by 3. MIA +1.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+1.8 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing -1.5 by 3. OVER 237.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 237.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread 76ers -1.5 → +1.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 42% of bets on Heat, 44% of the money — 76ers covered; total: 65% of bets on the over, 64% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 37% of bets on Heat, 55% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Heat, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.872 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +11.7 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 155 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.992 and gives home teams +0.1 points. Team corrections so far: Heat attack ×1.011, defense ×0.998 (10 games); 76ers attack ×1.018, defense ×1.028 (11 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
